title: OpenAPI Generator
description: Generate client SDKs, server stubs, and documentation from OpenAPI specifications.

data.text: `OpenAPI Generator` is a tool (available as a CLI, Maven plugin, and Docker image) that generates API clients, server stubs, and documentation from OpenAPI/Swagger definitions. It supports over 50 languages and frameworks.
OpenAPI Generator is commonly used via Docker or npm. For .NET, the Docker image is the most convenient option.

data.title: Generate a C# Client from OpenAPI Spec

data.text: A minimal OpenAPI 3.0 YAML definition that describes a simple API.

data.title: OpenAPI 3.0 Sample (petstore.yaml)
data.code:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Pet Store API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      summary: List all pets
      operationId: listPets
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of pets
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
components:
  schemas:
    Pet:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        name:
          type: string

terms.definition: A tool that generates code, docs, and config from OpenAPI specs.
A generated library that calls your API using typed models.
Generated skeleton code for implementing API endpoints.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Keep your OpenAPI spec as the single source of truth for your API.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: OpenAPI Generator supports C#, TypeScript, Python, and many more.
Generate clients to eliminate hand-written HTTP boilerplate.
Docker is the easiest way to run the generator.
data.takeaway: OpenAPI Generator bridges the gap between API design and client implementation.
